question: Which of the following plant groups bear naked seeds?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gymnosperms**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gymnosperms:**

 
 
• **The word gymnosperm means naked seed and the seeds are not enclosed inside the fruit but are instead exposed or on the scales of cones, like a pine cone. Hence, Option 2 is correct.**
 
• Gymnosperms belong to the kingdom ‘Plantae‘.
 
• The gymnosperms consist of s, cycads, gnetophytes, and the species of Gynkgophyta division and Ginkgo biloba.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://www.thoughtco.com/thmb/A-Q1IfYrNvSATz0x7DYOmwyMfo8=/1500x1000/filters:no_upscale():max_bytes(150000):strip_icc()/gymnosperm_life_cycle-5ae339893418c600374a14e6.jpg] 

 
• 
 
 
• The characteristics of Gymnosperms:

 
 
• They do not produce flowers.
 
• Seeds are not formed inside a fruit.
 
• They are not differentiated into an ovary, style, and stigma.
 
• Since stigma is not present, they are pollinated directly by the wind.
 
 
 
• Examples of Gymnosperms:
 
 
• Cycas
 
• Pinus
 
• Cedrus
 
• Picea
 
• Juniperus
